newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Backstrom says latest inflation data good.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Backstrom says latest inflation data good.

text.p: Urban Backstrom, governor of Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said he was satisfied with the latest economic statistics that he said boded well for future inflation developments.
"I think that in the last month we have seen good statistics on inflation," Backstrom told Swedish television late on Monday.

Asked if the statistics gave room for a new lowering of the bank's key interest rate, the repo rate, at this morning's weekly operation, he said: "It of course gives a central bank certain freedom of action."
Ahead of the day's repo tender, analysts were mixed on whether the Riksbank would further lower the repo rate that has been set at a fixed, unchanged 4.60 percent for the past four weeks.
The new seven day reverse repurchase operation will be announced at 0830 GMT.
Of 16 analysts questioned by Reuters, seven expected the repo rate to be trimmed while the rest expected the Riksbank to hold back, perhaps until it releases its next inflation report on December 17.
